# Recursive enum and independent key carrier inputs

A complete Object-bound binary carrier retains a recursive enum formal and an
independent method-owned key formal. Direct key and optional enum-default inputs
preserve their exact slots. Provider callbacks and interface dispatch return an
opaque enum independently of the default. Four frozen invocation paths run 192
fresh cases twice, observing nulls, raw defaults, input casts, callback and probe
mutation, exact throwable identity, and delayed concrete enum casts. Fifteen
wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the observers.
Source and SDK paths compile every emitted source and check all definitions,
roles, Signature and Exceptions attributes.
